layers.text: Subject: Thing in the Cellar, a chunky cute huge wide heap of a monster, a mound wider than it is tall: many fat rubbery deep-sea teal tentacles with pale cream suckers piled up and curling outward, many friendly round pale yellow eyes of different sizes with black pupils all over it, a broken weathered grey-brown wooden trapdoor round its middle like a collar, one tiny cream-and-blue striped party hat on top; no legs, no arms, no teeth; the lowest tentacles are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a silly friendly monster, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.

chibi-direction-cult-caller.subject: UNIT:CULT:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-cult-caller.notes: The Caller of the direction at the first creation: a round brass diving helmet with one green-lit porthole in place of a head, a blue robe, both mittens holding a cream conch horn as big as the body; 62 x 79 px, 4% green, no red or violet pixel. Seated 6 px above the canvas bottom, the foot line of the other large units. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-chosen.subject: UNIT:CULT:SWORDSMAN
chibi-direction-cult-chosen.notes: The Chosen of the direction as a sibling of the Initiate: a burly square block with one arm straight up and one finger at the sky (the Pick Me! pose), a cream sash with a brass medal across the chest, a big brass cleaver held low, a short hood; 56 x 73 px, the full canvas width, no green, red or violet pixel. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-familiar.subject: UNIT:CULT:RAIDER
chibi-direction-cult-familiar.notes: The Familiar: a fat blue winged toad-cat with a cream belly, pointed ears, a brass collar with a round bell and a closed smile; 58 x 65 px, no robe, no green, red or violet pixel; the lodge accent makes its hide the robes' indigo. It sits upright, not in mid-hop: a low blob with wings all the same. Seated 6 px above the canvas bottom. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-frog.subject: FROG
chibi-direction-cult-frog.notes: The frog of the direction at the first creation with the creature class: a fat squat teal frog with a cream belly and two big yellow eyes, 33 x 34 px on the 40 x 40 canvas, nothing under it; no green, red or violet pixel, so it is not a green frog lost on Grass. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-herald.subject: UNIT:CULT:HERALD
chibi-direction-cult-herald.notes: The Herald of the sample: a narrow starry indigo bell robe with empty sleeves, a brass collar ring, one huge pale yellow eye under a crown of curling teal tentacles; no hands, feet or tool. 53 x 97 px: as tall as the Brass Titan, 5 px under the Gingerbread Giant and 3 px under the 100 px of gate 3 (an edit keeps the canvas's outer 4 px clear). The cult-lodge accent lifts the navy robe to indigo. Fixed colours, no mask.

chibi-direction-cult-herald-unbound.subject: UNIT:CULT:HERALD_UNBOUND
chibi-direction-cult-herald-unbound.notes: The Unbound Herald: the accepted Herald with its one eye glowing red (101 px in the red band, none on the bound sprite) and the brass collar ring broken open at the front, on the same 53 x 97 px footprint and foot line; robe, stars and crown unchanged. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 beside the bound sprite.

chibi-direction-cult-hexer.subject: UNIT:CULT:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-cult-hexer.notes: The Hexer of the direction as a sibling of the Initiate: the hood's tip curls, brass spectacles sit on the hood over the two cream eyes, a green squiggle leaves the raised mitten; 50 x 73 px, 3% green, no red or violet. It holds a rolled cream scroll, not an open book. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-horror.subject: UNIT:CULT:HORROR
chibi-direction-cult-horror.notes: The Horror of the sample: a teal ball with a wide cream-toothed grin, two pale yellow googly eyes, a brass spiked collar with a chain, a cream belly and four curling tentacle feet; no cloth, hood, horns or flame. The cult-green accent pins a few lime specks and moves the last purple shadow pixels to the body's navy. Fixed colours, no mask. The eyes are nearly the same size.

chibi-direction-cult-horror-unbound.subject: UNIT:CULT:HORROR_UNBOUND
chibi-direction-cult-horror-unbound.notes: The Unbound Horror: the accepted Horror with both eyes glowing red (164 px in the red band, none on the bound sprite) and the trailing chain gone, on the same 68 x 68 px footprint and foot line; the grin shows more teeth and the body is a shade darker. The collar's crack is a few dark pixels and does not read at board size: the red eyes carry the cue. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 beside the bound sprite.

chibi-direction-cult-idol-bearer.subject: UNIT:CULT:GUARD
chibi-direction-cult-idol-bearer.notes: The Idol Bearer of the direction as a sibling of the Initiate: both mittens up beside one big grinning pale stone idol head with two green eyes, as wide as the hood under it, two heads stacked; 43 x 71 px, 1% green, no red or violet pixel. It is not wider than the other robed units: the second head is its outline tell. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-initiate.subject: UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-cult-initiate.notes: The Initiate of the sample: floppy hood tip, two cream eyes in a black hood, cream candle with a green flame, papers, cream mittens and slippers. The cult-lodge accent pins the flame to hue 147 and lifts the navy-shaded cloth to indigo (mean #4e48b5, hue 243; 22% dark). Fixed colours, no mask. The papers are held in the hand, not under the arm, and the badge is a brass belt buckle.

chibi-direction-cult-stargazer.subject: UNIT:CULT:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-cult-stargazer.notes: The Stargazer: a big brass telescope on a wooden tripod pointing up and to the right, a small cultist bent to its eyepiece in a starry nightcap with a cream pompom, two cream eyes in a dark hood, a star chart on the ground; 68 x 54 px, 3% green (the lens and two small flames), no red or violet pixel. Seated 6 px above the canvas bottom. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-summoner.subject: UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-cult-summoner.notes: The Summoner of the direction as a sibling of the Initiate: a straight spike of a hood to the canvas top (36 x 75 px, the thinnest piece), a cream stole, a brass hand bell raised and a looped brass chain; no green, red or violet pixel. The stole is a collar and carries no sign. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.

chibi-direction-cult-tentacle.subject: UNIT:CULT:TENTACLE
chibi-direction-cult-tentacle.notes: The Tentacle: one thick teal tentacle rising from its base and curled over at the top, cream suckers down its inner side, one yellow eye at its tip, and no body, face, hole or water; 53 x 74 px, no green, red or violet pixel. Its base ends in a small curled tail on the ground. Seated 4 px above the canvas bottom. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow, Forest and both waters and in greyscale.
